info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Rhyolite Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Rhyolite Recliner Details Management API facilitates the creation of detailed entries for the Rhyolite Recliner product within the catalog. This API allows businesses to manage product information, enhancing the overall customer experience by ensuring that accurate and comprehensive details are available. Typical consumers include product managers and e-commerce platforms aiming to enrich their listings with detailed specifications. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline the process of adding new products to their catalog efficiently.

post.description: This operation allows you to create detailed information for Rhyolite recliners. Provide the necessary details in the request body to successfully add new information regarding Rhyolite recliners to the system.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for the Rhyolite Recliner. It includes all necessary information required to process the request and is formatted in JSON. Ensure that all fields conform to the defined schema for successful processing.

200.description: Successfully retrieved details for the recliner.

rhyolite_recliner_id.description: The unique identifier for the Rhyolite recliner.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person who requested the Rhyolite recliner.

quantity.description: The quantity of Rhyolite recliners being requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority.

unitPrice.description: The unit price of a single Rhyolite recliner.

CreateCatalogRhyoliteReclinerDetailReque.description: Request body for creating a new Rhyolite recliner order.
